item.weapon.ancient_glaive.name: Ancient Glave
item.weapon.ancient_glaive.flavour: The once-great worshippers of Osiris recognised one fact above all - life is but a brief reprieve from eternity.
item.weapon.ancient_sword.name: Ancient Sword
item.weapon.ancient_sword.flavour: Carve away the world, discard the ego, and in what remains lies earnest reality.[key.style.break_small][key.flavour.secret](Notes on a page - torn from the spine of the great Song and left to float in space luminiferous.)
